query: SELECT cc.nome, SUM(lc.valor) as total FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001 GROUP BY cc.nome UNION ALL SELECT cc.nome, SUM(ls.valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario ls JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE ls.periodoCustoId = 60001 GROUP BY cc.nome ORDER BY total DESC;
